content.short: SafePal is a crypto wallet ecosystem with hardware and software wallets for storing TON and other assets.
content.description: SafePal is a wallet provider covering hardware wallets, software wallets, and browser or mobile wallet access. Its site focuses on secure storage for major crypto assets, including Bitcoin, BNB, Ethereum, and token assets, with TON relevance coming from multi-chain asset support. It is a broad wallet ecosystem rather than a TON-only app. SafePal securely stores your crypto assets in the most simple and easy way. For TON users, SafePal Wallet is about account access and everyday fund management rather than liquidity routing or analytics.
